definitions.run_A: mean (ask−bid) in cents over two-sided states with ask > bid (ties excluded)
definitions.run_B: mean (ask−bid) in cents over two-sided states with ask >= bid (ties included at gap 0)
definitions.weighting: equal weight per print update; not volume-weighted on either run

verdict: Same partition of crossed vs not for the rate; the mean differs because Run B folds zero-gap ties into the uncrossed average. Run A's 4.93¢ is the mean over strictly positive spreads; Run B's 4.34¢ dilutes that mean with ties. Prefer A's definition for 'mean uncrossed gap' (gap on books that are open, not touching).
